title: 第6章
slug: 鍏堝氬悗鐖澶у彅鎴戞墠鎴愬勾
content_zh: 结婚不是买菜顾启气得不行，“你要气死我是不是，我告诉你，最后通牒，今天晚上给我回家”声音那么洪亮，身体那么硬朗，那那么容易被气死啊。顾墨把钥匙仍在桌子上，随意的开口，“今晚有应酬，回不去”“你老子我又不是没当过干部，那有那么多的应酬啊，而且就算有也给我推了，不然打断你的腿”“好啊，腿打断了不用工作，你养我”顾墨不痛不痒的开口。最后，两父子闹得不欢而散，顾启气呼呼的走了。不久，吕青燕打来电话，“顾墨啊，你们两父子怎么又吵架了啊，听妈一句话，今晚回来吃个饭，跟你爸谈谈心说说话，你们是父子，又不是仇人，别每次见面都是大眼瞪小眼的”“妈，我今晚真有应酬”“妈不管，妈已经好久没看见你了，难不成现在妈跟你见面还要预约啊，你是妈十月怀胎生的儿子，妈想你了，而且你又不是卖身给南华市，回个家国家还不容许啊”终于受不了吕青燕的苦情戏码，顾墨晚上还是回家了。在顾墨回家前，吕青燕那是对顾启再三叮嘱，“等下儿子回来，你千万不要吼他，有话慢慢说，别忘记了你今晚的目的，把儿子吼走了，什么事情都办不成”“我尽量，只要那不孝子不气我，我就跟他好好说话”顾启从鼻孔里哼了一声。“你们父子俩，上辈子肯定是仇人”顾启坐在沙发上，虽然头发有些花白了，但是精神气还是相当不错的，有时候还被吕青燕拉着去跳坝坝舞。所以尽管年过半百，但是身体很是硬朗，几乎没怎么生病。现在，顾启皱眉思索了一下，然后严肃的开口，“今年你多少岁了？”“我是你生的，我多少岁你还不知道啊”顾启立刻板起脸，不苟言笑，声音很洪亮，“我当然知道，我是问你你知不知道”“有什么事你就直说，没必要跟我绕圈子”不过大概，顾墨已经猜到他接下来要说什么话了。每次的开场白都不同，但是最后事情的核心都是那件事，他听都听烦了。“你今年已经二十九了，二十九是什么概念，意味着你即将踏入三十的行列，青春不在，总之我也不跟你废话，今年之内，你必须给我领一姑娘回来见父母，不然我就登报跟你断绝父子关系”顾墨脸上有着不耐烦，“结婚又不是买菜，你以为站满菜市场给我随便挑啊，我上那儿给你弄一姑娘回来，而且我现在不想结婚，再说了，就我这工作，就算结婚了，也只有离婚的份，谁受得了老公经常半夜回家啊”顾启脸部肌肉抽搐，立刻打断了他的话，“照你这么说，当总裁就结不了婚，那全中国那么多个市，那些总裁都只能打光棍了啊，顾墨，我就告诉你，甭给我找借口，你必须在三十岁之前给我结婚”顾墨站起来，已经没有要继续谈下去的意思了，“总之我暂时没有结婚的打算，好了，这个话题到此为止，吃完饭我还要回去的”
content_en: Marriage is not about shopping for groceries. Gu Qi was so angry that he said, "You are going to piss me off, right? Let me tell you, the ultimatum is, come home tonight." His voice was so loud and his body was so tough. How could he be pissed off so easily? Gu Mo left the key on the table and said casually, "I have a social event tonight, I can't go back." "It's not like I've never been a cadre. There are so many social events, and even if I did, I would push them away, otherwise I'd break your leg." "Okay, you don't have to work if your leg is broken, you support me," Gu Mo said calmly. In the end, the two father and son broke up unhappy, and Gu Qi left angrily. Not long after, Lu Qingyan called, "Gu Mo, why are you two father and son quarreling again? Listen to Mom, come back for a meal tonight and talk to your dad. You are father and son, not enemies. Don't glare at each other every time we meet." "Mom, I really have a party tonight." "Mom, no." "No matter what, Mom hasn't seen you for a long time. Is it possible that Mom has to make an appointment to see you now? You are my son who was born in ten months of pregnancy. Mom misses you. Besides, you didn't sell yourself to Nanhua City, and the country doesn't allow you to return home." Finally unable to bear Lu Qingyan's painful drama, Gu Mo went home at night. Before Gu Mo went home, Lu Qingyan repeatedly warned Gu Qi, "When your son comes back later, you must not yell at him. Speak slowly if you have anything to say. Don't forget your purpose tonight. If you yell at your son away, nothing will be accomplished." "I will try my best. As long as that unfilial son is not angry with me, I will talk to him properly." Gu Qi snorted from his nostrils. "You two, father and son, must have been enemies in the last life." Gu Qi was sitting on the sofa. Although his hair was a little gray, he was still in good spirits. Sometimes he was pulled by Lu Qingyan to dance the baba dance. So even though he is over fifty, his body is very strong and he rarely gets sick. Now, Gu Qi frowned and thought for a moment, and then said seriously, "How old are you this year?" "I was born by you, and you don't know how old I am." Gu Qi immediately straightened his face, sternly smiling, and said in a loud voice, "Of course I know, I'm asking you if you know." "If you have anything to say, just tell me, there is no need to beat around the bush with me." But probably, Gu Mo had already guessed what he was going to say next. The opening line was different every time, but in the end the core of the matter was the same thing, and he was tired of hearing it. "You are already twenty-nine this year. What is the concept of twenty-nine? It means that you are about to enter the ranks of thirty, and your youth is gone. Anyway, I won't talk nonsense to you. Within this year, you must bring me a girl back to meet my parents, otherwise I will publish it in the newspaper and disown you. Gu Mo said with impatience on his face, "Marriage is not shopping for groceries. Do you think you can stand in the market and let me pick whatever you want? I'll go there and get you a girl. And I don't want to get married now. Besides, with my job, even if I get married, the only option is divorce." Who can bear to have a husband come home often in the middle of the night?" Gu Qi's facial muscles twitched and he immediately interrupted, "According to what you said, you can't get married as a CEO. In so many cities in China, those CEOs can only be singles. Gu Mo, I will sue. I tell you, don’t make excuses for me, you must marry me before the age of thirty." Gu Mo stood up and had no intention of continuing the conversation, "Anyway, I have no plans to get married for the time being, okay, this topic is over, I will go back after dinner."
novel_title: 先婚后爱,大叔,我才成年
